characters.name: In General
characters.description: Abusive Parents:Played for Laughsin "Fatklok". They're completely irresponsible to their new adopted kid, treating him more like a pet, naming him "Fatty Ding-Dongs", refusing to keep him from eating unhealthy foods and insteadneuteringhim in a misguided attempt to correct his rowdy behavior, tasering him when he continued to misbehave and finally leashing him to a pole on the front lawn of Mordhaus. When they decide that they can't keep taking care of him anymore, rather than returning him to a foster home, they just leave him on Krangor Island... which they've recently filled with wild, feral cats that quickly maul Fatty. The Alcoholic: All the members are constantly drinking. When they go to the grocery store to buy the ingredients for a meal, Nathan has to outright state that they shouldn't just buy booze, to which Murderface says he would rathercut his dick offthan accept that booze isn't food. Alcohol-Induced Idiocy: Happens nearly every time they touch alcohol. They'resomewhataware that they tend to make very poor decisions when drunk (at one point Nathan describes one of Charle's duties as talking them out of any stupid ideas they get excited about when under the influence), though it doesn't stop them from chugging the stuff at all. Aloof Big Brother: Not by blood, but all of them act this way towards Toki to varying degrees, withmoments of caringsprinkled in.Skwisgaar, in particular, stands out. Apocalypse Maiden: The Tribunal believes Dethklok has a connection to the eponymous end-of-the-world prophecy. Dethklok's music itself seems to cause insanity and chaos to ensue. The process that Dethklok's scientists developed for Dethklok to record music onto water causes entire landscapes to turn to blight.

characters.name: Skwisgaar Skwigelf
characters.description: The band's legendarily skilled lead guitarist. An incurable manslut, and raging egotist. Alliterative Name:SkwisgaarSkwigelf. Uniquely havingfourletters of his first and last name being similar. Always Someone Better: A rare dual example with Toki. While he is the superior musician, this is because he has more experience and practices constantly. Toki is the second-greatest guitarist in the world on pure talent, as Swisgaar regularly points out thathe doesn't practice. It is revealed inDoomstar RequiemthatSkwisgaar recruited Toki for Dethklok, despite beating him in their guitar duel, specifically to invoke this trope. According to Skwisgaar, the looming threat that is Toki surpassing him is the only thing that motivates him to put in the effort necessary tostaythe world's best guitarist. Ambiguously Bi: His legendary womanizing is practically his biggest character trait, but it's implied he had (multiple) threeways with Melmord, and following Dethklok's banter about the homo-eroticism of eating phallic-shaped foods, he comments "I would eat a hotdog. Just putting that out there." Animal Motifs: Hawks and wolves.In "Doomstar Requiem", it's horses.

characters.name: Toki Wartooth
characters.description: Rhythm guitarist, and shortest tenured member of the group. Bears a nagging inferiority complex, and endless scarring memories from his childhood. Absurd Phobia: He freaks out when seeing a Bicentennial coin that he had to be put in a medically induced coma to calm him down. That and Dr. Rockso running away from his concert brought him to aHeroic BSoDthe others had to snap him out off. Murderface stealing a whole bag of Franklin Mintsbrought him back to his coma again. Abusive Parents: He was treated horribly by both his parents as a child and they seemed to view him more as a slave than anything else, forcing him to do back-breaking hard labor and imprisoned him in a dark pit if he didn't do what they wanted. His father whipped, chained, and beat him for the slightest infractions, while his mother was emotionally abusive, glaring at her son and enabling her husband's behavior. This led him to be very insecure as an adult and was probably the reason why he acts so childish due to not being able to live like a kid when he was younger. He still fears his parents as an adult, his father in particular. Always Second Best: Played with. He's this to Skwisgaar, in terms of skill, but arguably its the other way around when it comes to raw talent. It's stated repeatedly that Toki never practices, whereas Swisgaar constantly has a guiltar in his hands, and yet Toki is the only guitarist alive who is able to keep up with him. Swisgaar seems to be the only person who is aware of this, however, and lives in fear of Toki actually working hard and surpassing him.Toki's repressed issues about this trope emerge in "Fatherklok", where he's being excited of replacing Skwisgaar as lead guitarist due to Skwisgaar'sDisappeared Dadissues keeping him from functioning normally. This continues until Nathan slaps him hard in the face and tells him towake the fuck up. Toki's repressed issues about this trope emerge in "Fatherklok", where he's being excited of replacing Skwisgaar as lead guitar

characters.name: William Murderface
characters.description: Bass player. Lazy, disliked and just a generally repulsive human being. All of the Other Reindeer: In the comics, Murderface was frequently subject to severe bullying in high school, which later drove him to set a school bus on fire with his classmates still inside. In the show, despite being a world-famous celebrity and a member of Dethklok, he doesn't get much respect due to beingthe bassist, his ugliness, and his overall repulsive personality. Ambiguously Bi: Murderface plays this tropehard- to the point where heflips outif it's even hinted that he is gay, yet his behavior in certain episodes (e.g. "Dethfashion", "Dethhealth") suggests that he is. He's also shown attraction to Skwisgaar's mom Serveta in "Dethmas", and even tries to hook up with her in "Fatherklok". And Zoidberg: It is repeatedly stated that Murderface is the least popular and respected member of the band, to the point where many fans don't even recognize him as an actual band member at all. There are even times where the others turn off Murderface's amp for entire concerts without anyone noticing. Angrish: Reduced to this when the new band therapist Dr. Twinkletits denied him a banana sticker.

characters.name: Pickles the Drummer
characters.description: Drummer/songwriter. One of the more stable members, despite a staggering alcohol problem and crappy family. The Alcoholic: While the entire band could be described this way, the label applies most obviously to Pickles, whose drinking manages to put even the other members of the band to shame. It seems to be a holy calling for him: when his former band reforms without him and headlines an anti-alcohol event, he takes it as a mortal offense.Pickles' drinking is also a not-so-subtle nod to his Wisconsin roots. Pickles' drinking is also a not-so-subtle nod to his Wisconsin roots. All Drummers Are Animals: Zigzagged. He binges on more alcohol and drugs than the rest of the band, but he is also the most experienced and multi-talented from his time in Snakes N' Barrels. By Season 4, he is one of the most responsible members of Dethklok. Always Second Best: Pickles seems to view himself as this for his parents, being doomed to always play second fiddle to Seth, his lazy, mooching, con-man douchebag of an older brother. This is despite Pickles being a musician of many talents and a multi-billionaire.

characters.name: Nathan Explosion
characters.description: Lead singer/songwriter/general musical genius of the band. All Just a Dream: The intro to "Go Forth and Die", where he dreamed thatCreepy Crowskilled his bandmates and forced him to become aBurger Fooljust to get by. And I Must Scream: InArmy of the Doomstar,after Nathan makes aliteral misinterpretationof Salacia'sinitial offer, Salacia angrily vows that he'll "crucify [Nathan]" and make the man his immortal plaything that he'll torture for eternity once Dethklok is destroyed. Fortunately, this doesn't happen. Animal Motifs:"Dethcarraldo" associates Nathan with alligators, as a vision showed him as a humanoid-looking alligator with his hair and stocky build. Alligators often represent danger; while this can refer to the Tribunal, whose members oppose Dethklok and see them as a threat to their plans, it can also mean danger in a personal sense, as Nathan'sLack of Empathyis a major flaw that has caused problems for himself, his bandmates, and others. Alligators also represent strength, protection, and rebirth, all which play a part in Nathan'sCharacter DevelopmentinDoomstar RequiemandArmy of the Doomstaras he starts seeing and treating his bandmates as his brothers instead of beinghis usual self, and actually relies on his fans to help Dethklok defeatMr. Salacia.By Seasons 3 and 4, Nathan became associated with whales through the Sea Prophet. Whales represent wisdom, harmony, and longevity; the Sea Prophet is a benevolent whale who communicates to Nathan via psychic dreams, her words influencing his actions likedestroying the Master Recordso Dethklok could eventually defeat the Tribunal. Her question to Nathan on whether he will be "the fist or the hand" serves asArc WordsforArmy of the Doomstar.It's implied that she is an ancient goddess far powerful than even Mr. Salacia, as she kills him bybiting his god form in halfand dragging his corpse to the depths of the sea in the climax. "Dethcarraldo" associates Nathan with alligators, as a vision showed him as a humanoid-

characters.name: Magnus Hammersmith
characters.description: Ex-member of Dethklok, kicked out for his controlling and deranged nature. A Fate Worse Than Death: His desired revenge against the band is simultaneously more kindandmore brutal than just killing them. He wants to bring them down to his level of obscurity, making them into "regular jackoffs". The band has repeatedly stated if they couldn't be famous, they'd just kill themselves. Affably Evil:He's seen stitching and cleaning the stab wound he gave Toki in "The Doomstar Requiem".He also saves Toki from dying from diabetic shock in "Dethcamp". Ambiguously Brown: His physical appearance is remiscient of Serj Tankian fromSystem of a Down, who is Armenian. Beard of Evil: Has a Goatee of Evil.

characters.name: Charles Foster Offdensen
characters.description: CFO/asskicker for Dethklok, and person who keeps them from financially imploding. The Ace: Charles is effectively the most competent character of the series and with the exception of getting the band to actually listen to him there's nothing he can't do. Ambiguously Absent Parent: In "Fatherklok" where he tries to get Skwisgaar toopen up a bit more regarding his father issues, where he refers to his own father exclusively in the past tense and remarks about how it feels to lose the "might of a father's touch". Although the exact meaning and significance of the scene aren't really explained. Ambiguously Trained: How one earth he got so good at hand to hand combat and became a tactical expert we may never know. Let alone why he decided to apply thisto a death metal band of all things! Arch-Enemy: To the Metal Masked Assassin. When any big fights occur you can be sure these two are gonna gun for each other first.

characters.name: Dick Knubbler
characters.description: Dethklok's former producer and current sound engineer. Originally a mole for the Tribunal, he defects due to the power of Dethklok's music and becomes a semi-capable employee. Artificial Limbs: His robotic eyes. Boxed Crook: He was facing many years in prison for tax evasion, disfiguring a co-worker's face with acid, and soliciting prostitution and drugs. The Tribunal offered to erase his criminal record if he spied on Dethklok for them as their sound engineer. Considering how he ended up working for Dethklok for real, it's safe to assume that Dethklok ended up clearing said record. Eye Scream: At the end of "Dethwater", while trying to escape a giant mutant seahorse, he resurfaces his sub too quickly. This makes his eyes literally explode. He receives his robot eyes afterward. Go Out with a Smile:Gives Nathan one last wry smirk before being obliterated by missiles inArmy Of The Doomstar.

characters.name: Johnathan Twinkletits
characters.description: A wacko band therapist hired to help Dethklok get along. AcCENT upon the Wrong SylLABle: His name is pronounced "Twink-LET-its" rather than Twinkle Tits. Artificial Limbs/Hollywood Cyborg: Gains some prosthetic, high-tech limbs after being ripped apart by wolves. Ax-Crazy: When his old band, "The Amazelingtons" kicked him out, he snapped and killed all of his ex-bandmates. He tried to do the same to Dethklok when they tried to fire him. Back for the Finale:He appears as a member of the army of Dethklok's fans and friends alongside Charles, Jean-Pierre and others to give Dethklok some much needed backup against the Tribunal's forces.

characters.name: Abigail Remeltindtdrinc
characters.description: A music engineer sent by Crystal Mountain Records after the firing of Dick Knubbler, taking over his role as Dethklok's new producer. Back Stab:Gets backstabbedthrough the stomachby one of the Revengencers during their ambush at Roy Cornickelson's funeral in "Church of the Black Klok". Fortunately, she survives. The Big Damn Kiss:With Nathan at Doomstar's conclusion. Crucified Hero Shot:She gets crucifiedupside-downalong with Toki when Dethklok finally finds them near the brink of death. Damsel in Distress:Kidnapped by Magnus Hammersmith in "The Doomstar Requiem" to be used as bait to lure in Dethklok.

characters.name: Jean-Pierre
characters.description: Band chef. Despite helicopter rotor mutilation and patchwork reassembling by Dethklok, he's still an expert chef. And I Must Scream: Dethklok prodding at his dismembered body in a comatose state. Back for the Finale:Reappears inArmy Of The Doomstaras a member of an army comprised of Dethklok's fans, friends and associates coming to the band's rescue from the Tribunal's army. Literal-Minded: Took Nathan's request for a "totally metal" birthday cake quite literally in "Birthdayface" by using mercury, an extremely poisonous metallic substance, as a main ingredient. Nervous Wreck: Very nervous and agitated in his introduction, though very much a case of beingProperly Paranoidconsidering what happened to all the previous chefs.

characters.name: Klokateers
characters.description: The band's expendable, numerous bodyguards and general workhorses. Battle Butler: The Klokateers serve as roadies, bodyguards, enforcers, and personal servants to Dethklok. Bodyguarding a Badass: The Klokateers, already badass themselves, serve as servants, enforcers, and protectors to Dethklok, whose members are talented musicians and world-wide celebritiesand also probably godlike beings with hidden power andthe chosen onesas predicted by the Church of the Black Klok. Of course, they're largely inept in most matters outside of music so having an army of fanatically loyal roadies mostly help keep them from dealing with the worst of their consequences. Faceless Goons: The hoods never come off. It's a part of their identity being erased. Happiness in Slavery: Paid a pittance. Live in diseased squalor. Likely to die within a day. Totally loyal to Dethklok.

characters.name: Facebones
characters.description: Mascot: Of all Dethklok's informative videos Oracular Head: He's basically a giant, talking skull. Phrase Catcher: "Yay, Facebones!" Tear Off Your Face: Patterned after a face minus its flesh. Vocal Dissonance: Speaks in a fairly high, cartoony voice (unless the recording is corrupted, which happens often).

characters.name: Oscar and Rose Explosion
characters.description: Abusive Parents: Subverted. They are actually very good parents to Nathan overall, which resulted in him being more emotionally and socially adjusted compared to his bandmates.Still, Rose tends to mother Nathan a little too much and once screamed at him for ruining her vagina (though in context, it's meant to tell him and the rest of the band off for thinking that their families don't know how to be brutal like them).Meanwhile, Oscar resents Nathan for making him give up his drinking to raise him, though they later patch things up thanks to Explosion Hot Sauce in "Skwisklok". Come by "Fatherklok," Nathan openly states that he loves his dad and that his dad is "f**king awesome". Still, Rose tends to mother Nathan a little too much and once screamed at him for ruining her vagina (though in context, it's meant to tell him and the rest of the band off for thinking that their families don't know how to be brutal like them). Meanwhile, Oscar resents Nathan for making him give up his drinking to raise him, though they later patch things up thanks to Explosion Hot Sauce in "Skwisklok". Come by "Fatherklok," Nathan openly states that he loves his dad and that his dad is "f**king awesome". Good Parents: To Nathan, in a stark contrast to the parents of his bandmates. Oscar is especially noteworthy when compared to the other fathers who are either emotionally abusive (Calvert), physically abusive (Aslaug), absent (Skwisgaar's father), or dead (Murderface's father). Nathan must have loved his dad very much to openly state, in front of his bandmates, that he loves him and they hang out together a lot. In the Blood: Oscar has an impressive pair of lungs and a growling voice, though not to the extent of his son.

characters.name: Thunderbolt and Stella Murderface
characters.description: All Part of the Show: The band adds Thunderbolt's hisMadness Mantrato their family song. And I Must Scream: Thunderbolt was unable to speak until he got an advanced wheelchair that allowed him to communicate. Once he has it, he begs for death. Death Seeker: Thunderbolt, because his body was failing him.He got his wish second season. Drives Like Crazy: Stella, on a mobility scooter of all things. Ironically, she's the complete opposite when it comes to driving an actual car. Gruesome Grandparent: Stella in particular has been shown to be abusive towards Murderface, such as pepper-spraying him at one point.

characters.name: Calvert, Molly and Seth
characters.description: Pickles's family. Calvert and Molly are his parents, while Seth is his older brother. Abusive Parents: Pickles constantly has to play"Well Done, Son" Guyto his parents, who favor Seth, Pickles' manipulative con-man of a brother. Calvert went as far as to have told Pickles that he "...belongs in a garbage can" when out of their home he was kicked out of their home as a teen. In "Dethwedding", they blatantly display their favoritism of Seth to Pickles in front of his friends when they visit his home in Tomahawk. It's also possible that all members of Pickles' family subjected him to mental and physical abuse as well. Big Brother Bully: Seth was certainly this to Pickles,as he wrongfully blamed him for setting their father's garage on fireand kept mooching off of him by emotionally blackmailing him for money. Bitch in Sheep's Clothing: A male example in Seth.Molly acts like a sweet and polite midwest mom, but is incredibly callous to Pickles, and 'Motherklok' reveals she's an absolute miserable crone who constantly nags Pickles no matter what does or how well he does it. Which makes her absolute heartbroken shock when he tells her off all the more satisfying. Molly acts like a sweet and polite midwest mom, but is incredibly callous to Pickles, and 'Motherklok' reveals she's an absolute miserable crone who constantly nags Pickles no matter what does or how well he does it. Which makes her absolute heartbroken shock when he tells her off all the more satisfying.

characters.name: Serveta Skwigelf
characters.description: Skwisgaar'sabsolute whore of a mother, seemingly sustained by having sex as much as possible. Abusive Parents:To say she is a promiscuous slut would be an insult to promiscuous sluts everywhere. She was extremely emotionally neglectful to Skwisgaar growing up, and she constantly had sex with complete strangers knowing that Skwisgaar would see, but made absolutely no effort in shielding her son (considering how traumatizing sex can be to a child's mindset). Sure, her son became a world-famous guitarist because of it, but he also became anAttention Whore, developed deep-seatedpsychological issuesregarding his mother and the absence of his biological father, and gained her rampant promiscuity. Alliterative Name:ServetaSkwigelf. Dumb Blonde: Just like her son, unfortunately. Gag Lips: Has prominent lips compared to the other females in this show.

characters.name: Aslaug and Anja Wartooth
characters.description: Abusive Parents: Aslaug, who was apparently a reverend, would regularly abuse and treat Toki cruelly. The level of physical and emotional abuse Toki endured from him was ridiculous, yet Toki loved his father enough to try to give him his dying wish. Toki also has at least one memory of his mother, Anja, glaring at him before slapping him across the face so it's very likely she shares some portion of the blame for Toki's horrible childhood.This aspect of her character seems to be completely gone after her husband's death, as she starts enjoying life a little more in "Dethmas" after Aslaug's death while Toki simply treats her with the same embarrassed disdain the other bandmates do to their mothers including Nathan who's mother isn't abusive to him in the slightest. It's also worth noting the one time we saw her slap him, Aslaug was standing behind her staring intensely, implying it was on his command. Asshole Victim:Aslaug, after he drowns in a frozen lake in Season 2. Given what he did to Toki during his entire childhood, it's very deserved. Even Anja, his own wife, didn't mourn him, and indulged in all kinds of activities with the Dethklok mothers that Aslaug would've been appalled at once he's dead. Death Glare: Both... to Toki... constantly. Domestic Abuse:Very lightly implied. Aslaug was evidently the most abusive towards Toki, and when Anja herself slapped Toki, Aslaug was right behind her, staring intensely, implying it was on his command. Some time after Aslaug dies, Anja is more than willing to indulge herself, like getting a makeover, getting drunk with the other mothers of Dethklok, and even being involved in sex, suggesting that Aslaug might have coerced her... The Dreaded:Their influence on Toki was so horrible that when Dethklok's families are introduced in "Dethfam", Toki spends most of the episode mute and catatonic in shock just by his parents being there.Downplayed if not entirely averted regarding just his mother. He has no problem talking to her i

characters.name: Senator Stampingston
characters.description: Mr. Expositionfor the Tribunal. Ambiguous Situation: He's revealed in "The Doomstar Requiem" tobe helping Mr. Salacia usher in the Metalocalypse, being present as they discuss Dethklok and General Crozier's mind-control. It's never made clear if he has some sort ofhidden connection to Mr. Salacialike Vater Orlaag, or is simplyBrainwashedlike General Crozier."Army of the Doomstar" subtly clarifies this by revealingSalacia, as the "Half Man" can only split his consciousness between two bodies at a time before his physical form starts to deteriorate, suggesting that Stampingston's devotion to Salacia may have been genuine. Though his absence from most of the secret meetings prior to "Requiem" make it unclear how long he's been in on the secret. Catchphrase: When the Tribunal appears on screen, he always prefaces his exposition with "Gentlemen..." Consummate Professional: Relatively-speaking, he's the most level-headed and professional member of the Tribunal, virtually never losing his cool and occasionally reigning in the other members. In contrast to General Crozier, he never suggests doing more than simply monitoring Dethklok and gathering information discretely, as per the orders of Mr. Salacia. Flat Character: Other than starting off the Tribunal meetings, there's not much else to him.

characters.name: Vater Orlaag
characters.description: Ravenwood's replacement, and general lackey to Salacia. Beard of Evil: A very bushy beard, on a very bad man. The Dragon:Appears to be Mr. Salacia's second-in-command, and also the only one aware of his true nature. Enigmatic Minion: Very little about his character has been revealed. His job description is vague ("political and spiritual specialist"). His title and appearance would suggest that he is some sort of monastic, but his religious affiliation is unclear. He also has his own private army. He seems very loyal to and trusted by Mr. Salacia, addressing him as "Master" and having telepathic access to his thoughts. Anything beyond that is anyone's guess. Evil Brit: Courtesy ofMalcolm McDowell.

characters.name: Mr. Salacia
characters.description: The mysterious leader of the Tribunal. Although very interested in Dethklok's activities, the council is forbidden from interfering with or eliminating the band, under his specific orders. Disobeying him is a very,verybad idea. Badass in a Nice Suit: Wears a suit and tiewhich he retains even in his true form. Batman Gambit: The final stages of hisEvil Planrely heavily on this.After heMind Rapesand corrupts Murderface, he uses him to expose the location of the Army of the Doomstar and hamper the band's creative process, putting them off writing and performing the Song of Salvation, allowing the Doomstar to lay waste to much of the earth. Beard of Evil: Evil to the core, with a slick white beard to match. Big Bad: OfMetalocalypse. He spends most of his timehanging out in his headquarters with the rest of the Tribunal, but it's clear that he and his men are actively working behind the scenes in order tofind the right time to strike.ByArmy of the Doomstar, he's thoroughly established as the biggest threat Dethklok has ever dealt with, to the point where they spend the entire film preparing to deal with him once and for all.

characters.name: Cardinal Ravenwood
characters.description: Original religious member of the Tribunal. Big Bad Duumvirate: With Crozier in Season 1, as they both conspire to eliminate Dethklok behind Salacia's back. Drops out ofBig Badstatus afterward. Cruel and Unusual Death:His organs were dissected by Salacia. Eye Scream:By Salacia. Killed Off for Real:By Salacia.

characters.name: Agent  216
characters.description: An assassin hired by General Crozier to kill Dethklok under the guise of intel gathering. Fall Guy: Duringhis funeral, Dethklok decides to blame him for the embezzlement after finding out they were the one's taking money from their own company. Charles makes no objections. Informed Ability: Despite Crozier's claim that he is aProfessional Killer, he is thwarted at every attempt to kill Dethklok, repeatedly accosted by a midget Klokateer, and is ultimately killed by falling headfirst into Murderface's codpiece. Killed Off for Real: He is killed when the midget Klokateer grabs his foot right when he's about to shoot Dethklok, causing him to trip and fall face-first onto Murderface's diamond encrusted codpiece. Professional Killer: He is a trained killer according to Crozier, and it's a trait that he shares with his brother, the Metal Masked Assassin.

characters.name: Metal Masked Assassin
characters.description: The brother of Agent 216, he is another brutal assassin hired by Crozier to kill Dethklok. When he fails, he becomes Dethklok's (or more specifically, Charles') sworn enemy. Arch-Enemy: To Offdensen, ever since he beat him during his first attempt on Dethklok's life. MMA had it out for the manager ever since. He manages to gain the advantage in the next two meetings (he blindsides Offdensen during a hospital charity gig and throws him out the window only for Offdensen to land safely on his feet. The second time he nearly kills him but Nathan knocks him out). Their last meeting however ended with Offdensen the victor though MMA manages to get away. Big Bad Duumvirate: With Edgar Jomfru during Season 2.Graduated to singularBig Badstatus in season 4, as he takes over the Revengencers, though it seems to be a duumvirate again inThe Doomstar Requiem, withMagnus Hammersmithas the other half,until the Assassin impales him and very briefly retakes the status for himself. Graduated to singularBig Badstatus in season 4, as he takes over the Revengencers, though it seems to be a duumvirate again inThe Doomstar Requiem, withMagnus Hammersmithas the other half,until the Assassin impales him and very briefly retakes the status for himself. The Brute: Any time he shows up, he always presents more of a major physical threat to Dethklok than any other character on the show in fact.

characters.name: Edgar Jomfru
characters.description: The wheelchair-bound half of the Jomfru brothers who tried and failed to blackmail Dethklok for money. Unlike Eric, he survives to plot his revenge on Dethklok.Ironically enough, he is revealed to be working with Charles by the Season 3 finale. With the following seasons having him become a fully fledged Klokateer. Edgar proves to be a very crucial ally to Dethklok, especially inDoomstar RequiemandArmy of the Doomstar. Acrofatic: Downplayed. Despite his obvious weight issues and disability, Edgar is a talented swimmer. He's able to swim out of Mordhaus' sewers (with the Teenager tied to his back) when he escapes in "Dethvengeance" and is shown practicing in a swimming pool at the Revengencers' base in one of the Season 2 DVD extras. Big Bad Duumvirate: With the Metal Masked Assassin during Season 2, then drops out of that status afterwardsdue to hisHeel–Face Turn. The Comically Serious: Due to his over-the-top voice and deadpan expressions, he can often fall into this trope.This makes hisWhat the Hell, Hero?moment in "The Doomstar Requiem" even more powerful. Disproportionate Retribution: His younger brother gets killed for trying to blackmail Dethklok.

characters.name: The Teenager
characters.description: A teenager imprisoned by Dethklok for pirating their songs. He wears the face of Eric Jomfru as a mask. Disproportionate Retribution: He gets imprisoned and tortured in the bowels of Mordhaus forSTEALING A FREAKING DETHKLOK SONG ONLINE. Gonk: Even without thathorrifying skin mask, he's... not a cute kid, to say the least. One of his eyes randomly slides away as he scoffs at Dethklok's piracy warning, showing that he has crossed eyes. Jerkass: When he was a carefree teen before being imprisoned. Malevolent Masked Man: A nightmarish variation; Edgar Jomfru has him wear a mask of hisdead brother's face.

characters.name: Lavona Succuboso & Succuboso Explosion
characters.description: A group of women who are convinced Nathan can sire them a super race. Beehive Hairdo: The red-head agent, and it's an especially weird one. (She's usually seen right behind Lavona, and is the one who tests the loin extractor in "Klokblocked"). The blonde one, too. Black Comedy Rape: Their plan involves taking advantage of a man without his consent and using him as a baby factory to produce a race of super-soldiers to conquer the world with. Despite this, it isn't treated very seriously. Breeding Cult: Their plans revolve around getting impregnated by Nathan, which will somehow result in superhuman offspring. Cleavage Window: Their outfits are designed with this.

characters.name: Dr. Rockzo
characters.description: A cocaine-addicted reprobate who dresses like a clown and is a frequent annoyance to Dethklok (minus Toki). In his prime, he was the famous frontman of a clown-themed, glam-rock band called Zazz Blammymatazz. Addled Addict: His drug addiction has absolutely ruined his life, as well as any attempts to return to stardom. In "Cleanzo", even admits he not only does cocaine, he also huffs paint, does crystal meth, heroin, pain pills, and oxycontin before finally admitting, "I do it all!" If Nathan is to be believed, previous attempts to reunite Zazz Blammymatazz have ended in failure largely due to Rockzo ingesting drugs, usually cocaine. While he tried to get sober and succeeded in "Cleanzo", he ends up relapsing in "Snakes N' Barrels II" because he kept hallucinating his Dr. Rockzo persona. Amusing Injuries:His nose falls off at the very end of "Cleanzo", likely due to his extensive history of snorting cocaine, but by "Snakes N' Barrels II" it's reattached again with no explanation.According to Nathan, Rockzo stole money from a drug cartel andgot shot in the groinwhen he refused to give the money back, so now he "pees out of the side of his dick". It's treated as one of Rockzo's many misadventures and is never mentioned again. His nose falls off at the very end of "Cleanzo", likely due to his extensive history of snorting cocaine, but by "Snakes N' Barrels II" it's reattached again with no explanation. According to Nathan, Rockzo stole money from a drug cartel andgot shot in the groinwhen he refused to give the money back, so now he "pees out of the side of his dick". It's treated as one of Rockzo's many misadventures and is never mentioned again.

characters.name: Snakes N' Barrels
characters.description: A glam rock act formerly fronted by Pickles. When he left for Dethklok, the rest of the band hit the skids. They suddenly got a rise in popularity again after a Snakes N' Barrels documentary aired (no doubt thanks to Pickles' popularity) and even started a reunion tour with Pickles. Unfortunately, after they ingested the Tribunal's drug, "Totally Awesome Sweet Alabama Liquid Snake", they were rendered blank slates, except for Pickles thanks to a lifetime of drugs and alcohol. I Was Quite a Looker: The guys were okay-looking in their hey-day, but after Pickles left, theyreallystarted letting themselves go. They surprisingly became quite handsome again after they were rehabilitated and had Rikki Kixx be their new frontman. Lesser Star: The remaining band members after Pickles left. While Pickles became a world-famed death metal musician and a multi-billionaire, the rest of his old band fell into poverty and sobriety. In fact, the only reason the band even had a sudden rise in popularity again was because of a documentary about them mentioned how Pickles was one of them before he became the drummer for Dethklok. No Celebrities Were Harmed: As a whole, they're a parody of glam and hair metal bands likeGuns N' Roses. Like Guns N' Roses, Snakes N' Barrels was hugely popular in the 80s, but later became associated with heavy drug abuse and scandals, with the classic lineup being replaced by new members. Individually, members Thunderbottom, Candynose, and Bullets are based offSlash,Poisondrummer Rikki Rockett, andJoe Perryrespectively. No One Could Survive That!: After taking some very heavy drugs, the audience wondered if they overdosed.

characters.name: Dethklok Minute Host
characters.description: TV host of "The Dethklok Minute", a gossip program that reports on Dethklok's celebrity activities. Facial Horror: Relatively downplayed considering how brutal his initial injuries were. That said, his later appearances show what appears to be a trail of drool on his mouth so clearly some of his facial organs aren't as functional any more. No Celebrities Were Harmed: His looks and voice appear to be based on Billy Bush, former anchor of the celebrity gossip programAccess Hollywood. No One Could Survive That!: At the end of "P.R. Pickles",a fragment of a meteor strikes his studio and he's horrifically burnt in the ensuing explosion with his most of his skin seemingly melting off.He continues to show up later with fairly minor facial injuries and still as enthusiastic as ever. Perpetual Smiler: It's possible his injuries may be preventing him from doing other facial expressions but it's not like he ever stopped smiling even before that.

characters.name: Eric Jomfru
characters.description: The other half of the Jomfru brothers that tried to blackmail Dethklok for money. Unlike Edgar, he doesn't survive screwing with Dethklok. Big Brother Instinct:During a flashback in "The Doomstar Requiem", when they got in a car crash after attending a Dethklok concert and Edgar's legs were paralyzed underneath the overturned car, Eric managed to lift the car and carry Edgar to safety moments before the car exploded. Evil Genius: Subverted. After revealing his well thought-out plans to Dethklok, he was killed shortly afterward. Fat and Skinny: He was the skinny to Edgar's fat. Killed Off for Real: Sniped mercilessly by one of Dethklok's minions for threatening the band.

characters.name: Roy Cornickelson
characters.description: Head of Crystal Mountain Records and Dethklok's boss. The Dreaded: A more benevolent version. Even normally unflappable Charles (who handled possible Dethklok-induced nuclear Armageddon with poise) is nervous when Roy isn't happy. Heroic Sacrifice:Confronts Salacia solely to give Dethklok a chance to get away safely. Honest Corporate Executive: In comparison to hisJerkassson Damien (see below). Human Shield:His corpse was used as this by Offdensen in self-defense against the Metal Masked Assassin.

characters.name: Ishnifus Meaddle
characters.description: The leading priest of the Church of the Black Klok. Ancient Tradition: He's the leader of one that's been preparing to help Dethklok for thousands of years. Big Good: Leads the Church that's been preparing for the coming of Dethklok for thousands of years.The church's first confirmed action in the series is reviving fellowBig Good, Offdensen after he died witnessing Salacia's power.Offdensen also implies that the church has indirectly saved Dethklok's lives a number of times.When Offdensen leaves in "The Doomstar Requiem", he's the one that leads Dethklok and offers guidance in finding Toki. After he dies protecting Dethklok, Offdensen ends up taking his role as the high priest of the Church of the Black Klok. When Offdensen leaves in "The Doomstar Requiem", he's the one that leads Dethklok and offers guidance in finding Toki. After he dies protecting Dethklok, Offdensen ends up taking his role as the high priest of the Church of the Black Klok. Defiant to the End:As he faces down the Masked Assassin, he boldly states he doesn't fear him.

characters.name: The Whale Prophet
characters.description: A mysterious blue humpback whale Nathan starts communicating with in his dreams. Back for the Finale:After Dethklok manages to push back Salacia towards the ocean, she confirms her godhood byswallowing Salaciaand killing him. Big Good: It's implied she is this for the entire show. She advises Nathan to destroy Dethklok's then-latest albumwhich prevents the Tribunal from using the potential album profits to fund the Falconback Project, and true to her name, she gives vague prophecies that serve asForeshadowingfor later events.She turns out to be part of the Church of the Black Klok's prophecy as a drawing of her is included on a cave wall alongside Dethklok.InArmy of the Doomstar, she influences Nathan'scharacter growthwith the question "Will you be the fist or the hand?"and she shows up to kill Salacia after he's pushed to the sea by Dethklok, further implying that she might be a goddess of sorts. The Chooser of the One: Only Nathan was chosen by her to carry out her will, and much of his actions in season 4 onward were driven by this. Gentle Giant: She's a huge blue humpback whale, and she's a benevolent character who guides Nathan (and therefore Dethklok) in saving the world from the Tribunal, especially Salacia.

characters.name: Mustakrakish
characters.description: A Finnish lake troll summoned by Dethklok by accident, after performing an ancient folk song that awakens it from its sleep. All Trolls Are Different: is several stories tall with red skin, gangly limbs, claws, and fangs. It appears to hate (or enjoy destroying) modern technology, or at least high-tension electrical lines, and its only weaknesses seem to be lullabies (which put it to sleep in the bottom of a lake) and sharp objects lodged in its throat. And it's summoned with The Power of Rock. Do note that the Scandinavian members of Dethklok recognize it. Attack of the 50-Foot Whatever Killed Off for Real: He is killed when he accidentally swallows Murderface's spiky Dethphone, causing him to disembowel himself trying to remove it from his throat.

characters.name: Fatty Ding-Dongs
characters.description: A foster kid adopted by Dethklok under the mistaken assumption that it could be counted as a tax credit. Butt-Monkey: From his debut appearance, he's been tasered, neutered, chained to a pole, is fed only popsicles and discarded food scraps, and then gets left behind at an island full of wild cats that maul him. It's all played for comedy. Fat Bastard: Downplayed. He's just ill-behaved and wild, and Dethklok's treatment of him doesn't help at all. Fat Comic Relief: In case Dethklok's name for him didn't tip you off. He behaves more like a wild pig than a guy who's over 14 years old and he's introduced chewing on a brick wall. Foster Kid: In and out of foster homes for 14 years.

characters.name: Mashed Potato Johnson
characters.description: An old Mississippi blues man, who comes to teach Dethklok the power of the blues. Cool Old Guy:In the comics, he fights the ghost of a serial killer on a large train that Dethklok is performing on. While he gets some good hits in, the ghost is in a younger body, and overpowers him. Then Johnson summons the Blues Devil, and has the spirit taken down to hell, freeing his own soul.In his first appearance, he manages to breach the gates of Mordhausby himselfwithout a scratch on him.While Dethklok is playing "Murdertrain a Comin'" on the first Dethalbum's bonus disc, Johnson pops in and does some blues guitar soloing, and is even able to get Skwisgaar to slow his guitar down to match the tempo and melody - considering that Skwisgaar and Toki needed cinderblocks tied to their arms to slow down in "Bluesklok", this shows how well he's been able to teach them. He exits the song with a deep "Dethklok rules!" In the comics, he fights the ghost of a serial killer on a large train that Dethklok is performing on. While he gets some good hits in, the ghost is in a younger body, and overpowers him. Then Johnson summons the Blues Devil, and has the spirit taken down to hell, freeing his own soul. In his first appearance, he manages to breach the gates of Mordhausby himselfwithout a scratch on him. While Dethklok is playing "Murdertrain a Comin'" on the first Dethalbum's bonus disc, Johnson pops in and does some blues guitar soloing, and is even able to get Skwisgaar to slow his guitar down to match the tempo and melody - considering that Skwisgaar and Toki needed cinderblocks tied to their arms to slow down in "Bluesklok", this shows how well he's been able to teach them. He exits the song with a deep "Dethklok rules!"

characters.name: The Blues Devil
characters.description: A satanic entity who grants blues players fame in exchange for their souls, one of them being Mashed Potato Johnson. Deal with the Devil: Well, yeah. That said, he unfortunately ends up facing off against Dethklok in the field of negotiating terms, which they areinexplicably hyper-talented in.

characters.name: Juliette Sarmangsadandle
characters.description: A terminally ill little girl who wishes to meet her idol Toki before dying. Incurable Cough of Death: As her condition worsens. Kill the Cutie: By the end of "Dethkids". Larynx Dissonance: You can clearly tell she's voiced by a grown man. Littlest Cancer Patient: She's a terminally ill little girl who looks up to Toki. But since this isMetalocalypseand she gets close to Toki, she dies at the end of the episode.

characters.name: Rebecca Nightrod
characters.description: A raving bitch who becomes Nathan's brief girlfriend. Asshole Victim:HerStaircase Tumbleis played for comedy anddrags on and on, and given her behavior and treatment of Nathan, it's hard to feel sorry for her. Beauty Is Bad: A beautiful celebrity tennis player who is an utter bitch and treated Nathan like shit during their time together. Beauty Is Never Tarnished:Averted; after falling down several flights of stairs, she's in the hospital with a coma, her face heavily disfigured and missing some teeth. Double Standard: Abuse, Female on Male: Subverted, Nathan initially dismisses her verbal abuse and controlling behavior as just her being brutal, but is taken seriously by Dethklok. So much that they have to get Nathan to admit that he hates her and needs to break up with her, in which resulted in him crying from how badly she treats him.

characters.name: James Grishnack
characters.description: Slimy head of Behemoth Productions and producer of Dethklok's film, "Blood Ocean". Asshole Victim: He gets set on fire and evidently hospitalized. Given that his actions in the episode included trying to force outBlood Oceanagainst Dethklok's wishes, and physically abusing his underling (who is evidently his daughter), it's very hard to feel bad about it. Corrupt Corporate Executive: Aside from his cruelty, he openly tells Dethklok that he bought off as many critics as possible. Fat Bastard: Practically spherical in build and a horrible person. Jerkass Has a Point: His "shit sandwich" speech, though disgusting and placing him in opposition to Dethklok, does have a core of truth to it:Blood Oceanwas a huge production, and everyone involved stands to suffer as a result of it, himself as much as anyone. The film's disastrous state is almost entirely Dethklok's fault, and trying toPolish the Turdis really the only option left if they want to seeanyreturn on it. The only thing that makes this a problem for Dethklok is that they have a revenue stream independent of moviemaking; he doesn't.

characters.name: Alfred Belmer
characters.description: A cannibalistic baby murderer set to be publicly executed by Dethklok. Eats Babies: He's known for eating children, especially babies and toddlers. He's about to eat a baby at the end of "Dethecution", though it thankfully ends before it gets any further. I'm a Humanitarian: He murders babies to eat them. He previously provided the page image. Karma Houdini: He escapes the execution after Dethklok bungles the show, allowing himself and several other death row escapees to flee in the carnage. Would Hurt a Child: He killed 274 babies and toddlers, especially so he could eat them.

characters.name: Dimneld Selftcark
characters.description: Toki's guitar mentor. Dying Declaration of Love: Tells Toki he loves him as he dies in his arms. Nice Guy: He's a pretty good person who is patient with Toki and even appreciates a small childish gift from him. Parental Substitute: Forms a father-son bond with Toki. His last act is to tell Toki he loves him. Too Good for This Sinful Earth: Like all the good things and people Toki feels at least some affection for, he bites it.

characters.name: Dethklok's Doubles
characters.description: A group of body doubles for Dethklok, whom they quickly grow attached to during the episode "Dethdoubles".Unaware that they're secretly spies for the Tribunal. Badass Crew:When the time comes for them to take action, they quickly eliminate a whole squad of armed Klokateers as they try to steal Dethklok's business contracts. Body Double: What their whole purpose is. Body Horror:While trying to steal business contracts during a concert on a volcano, the volcano erupts gruesomely burning them beyond recognition withmost of them losing limbs in the process.Toki's double in particular is outright reduced to a head and torso. The band, unaware of the attempt, considered burning themselves to match, therefore keeping them employed. Consummate Professional: Dethklok spends a lot of time hanging out and having fun with them but they never drop their quiet, stoic demeanor the entire time.When reporting back to General Crozier, Nathan's double seems somewhat annoyed that the "palling around" is interfering with their ability to gain any substantial information.

characters.name: Eric von Wiechlinghammer
characters.description: A German fashion designer/mass murderer that Dethklok recruits for their clothing line. Ambiguously Gay: He dresses very camp and works in the fashion industry, and he was based on Karl Lagerfeld, who was also gay. Denied Food as Punishment: This is how he abused his models: starving them to death to use their skin as leather. Genuine Human Hide: He deliberately starvedfifty-sevenmodels to death, so he could use their skin as leather. No Celebrities Were Harmed:He's based onKarl Lagerfeld, whose obsession with thinness led to him abusing models.His blonde hair, gaunt appearance, and scary mannerisms are based onKlaus Kinski.

characters.name: Liz Bane
characters.description: Head of the Exodus P.R. Firm, she becomes Pickles' new P.R. Person and has a shady history of starting dangerous cults. Cold Ham: Even at her most expressive she doesn't drop her icy, calm demeanor. Cult: She was a former religious radical credited with starting dozens of them in the 70s.Her new P.R. firm is just a cover for her latest and most ambitious one yet. Evil Plan: The Tribunal suspects that with her new Exodus P.R. firm working with Pickles, she's planning something beyond mere public relations.Turns out she's turning Pickles into the most popular celebrity in the world in order to amass millions of followers for her latest cult. Her new "clients" then have all their possessions stolen as she has them tortured and brainwashed into subservience. As a favor for her, Pickles would convince the rest of Dethklok to perform a concert scheduled on the night in which Nile's Comet is nearest to Earth. Select followers would then drink poisoned grape juice before attending said concert. With Dethklok performing atop a special elevated platform on their newly built comet observatory, the comet would collide with the platform killing them all. The plan ended up failing because the comet ended up colliding with Dethklok's new "giant space publicity tablet", splitting into multiple pieces with one of which impacting her car as she was driving away from the observatory. Evil Sounds Deep: Speaks in a deeper, colder intonation than most of the other female characters on the show.

characters.name: Yaneemango Indians
characters.description: A tribe of cannibals from the Amazon from where Nathan is descended from. All Girls Want Bad Boys: Despite Otoe being the leader of a cannibal tribe, Nathan's grandmother lusted after him and later willingly became his wife, stating in her diary they were "powerful" together. Badass Native: The Yaneemango Indians are able to fight and kill Crozier's men despite wielding primitive weapons, matching the soldiers with sheer fanaticism and savagery. Chief Otoe, Nathan's maternal grandfather, is also this by virtue of being their leader when he was alive, and Nathan got his brutality from him. I'm a Humanitarian: The Yaneemango Indians are a tribe of cannibals. Nathan's grandmother discovered this when, after becoming Otoe's wife, she finds a pocket watch belonging to her original husband, Walter, in her soup. Small Role, Big Impact: Otoe is a very minor character, but he inadvertently saves the world from the Tribunal when he happens upon Nathan's grandmother and takes her in as his wife, leading to Nathan's birth.

characters.name: Kip Slaughter
characters.description: Governor of Florida, Nathan's home state. He getsslaughteredby Dethklok fans after insulting Nathan, prompting Nathan to succeed him as governor. Decapitation Presentation: His head is chopped off by an angry mob on live TV, and he has the word "dildo" written on his forehead. Meaningful Name: His last name is slaughter and well, that's his fate when he insults Dethklok right in front of their fanbase. Off with His Head!: How he dies. Patricide: Even his own daughter participated in his killing.

characters.name: Mr. Gojira
characters.description: Head of Gojira's Driving School, of which Skwisgaar and Toki are forced to attend after getting in trouble with the law via a high-speed chase. Asian Rudeness: He's an Asian driving instructor and he has a very caustic way of teaching. To the point that when overseeing Toki driving, Skwisgaar (who was at the backseat) tells him to leave Toki alone.

characters.name: Melmord Fjordslorn
characters.description: A sleazy second manager hired by Dethklok to be their pal. Bitch in Sheep's Clothing:Male example; he acted nice and lenient to Dethklok so he can gain power and influence over them, and steal their vast fortune for himself. Offdensen put an end to it permanently. Corrupt Corporate Executive: Subverted.He was hired by Dethklok because they think Offdensen was financially ripping them off, but he was planning to to gain power of attorney over the band so he can steal their fortune for himself. He never gets that far because Offdensen kills him in a fencing duel. Disney Villain Death:Falls off the roof of Mordhaus at the end of his duel with Offdensen though if you look closely he gets run through when he rushes Offdensen right before falling. If that didn't kill him, the train certainly did. Faux Affably Evil:He intentionally portrayed himself as a laid-back, fun-loving manager so Dethklok can trust him enough to handle their massive wealth, which he intended to have for himself. Offdensen caught on and killed him in a sword fight.

characters.name: Runke Snogge
characters.description: Toki's old friend from Norway. Hipster: Refuses to sell Dethklok albums at his shop Drep Du Selv, as he perceives them as "too digital".

characters.name: Rikki Kixx
characters.description: A rehab center spokesperson who weasels his way into being Snakes N' Barrels' new lead singer. Cold Turkeys Are Everywhere:Every time he wants to do drugs or alcohol, he's harshly reminded that he can't due to current health and legal problems. Evil Plan:He used to be really into alcohol and drugs until he was forced to stop because of his liver problems. He grew so embittered by this that he sought to deprive everyone of the pleasures he once enjoyed. Freudian Excuse:He used to heavily abuse drugs and alcohol until his health deteriorated too far for him to indulge anymore and it got him in trouble with the law, so he wants to deprive the world of the things he used to enjoy, just to watch them suffer as much as he did. No Celebrities Were Harmed: Of Nikki Sixx fromMötley Crüe. He also looks alotlikeMick Jagger.

characters.name: Damien Cornickelson
characters.description: Jerkassson of Roy who takes over Crystal Mountain Records when his father falls ill. Corrupt Corporate Executive: A far cry from his benevolent father, Roy. Drunk with Power: Once he controls Dethklok by being their label, oh boy... Evil Is Petty: Part of Damien's vendetta towards Dethklok is that Nathan punched him. To be fair, though, he shouldn't have provoked Nathan in the first place. Inadequate Inheritor: He's really nothing like his father and he knows it. He just doesn't care since he just wants the company for himself.

characters.name: Really Cool Cat
characters.description: A cat Toki saves (and later adopts) from one of Dethklok's concerts. Black Comedy Pet Death: He dies at the end of the episode from drinking alcohol Toki gave him during Dethklok's bender, but only Toki is affected while the rest of Dethklok are completely indifferent. It is shortly followed by averytrippy musical number, and the massive sarcophagus he was laid to rest in falls over and crushes the Sphinx statue in Egypt. Kill the Cutie: He's an adorable little cat, but since this isMetalocalypse, and he's close to Toki, of course he dies at the end of the episode.

characters.name: The Dentist
characters.description: A suicidal dentist whom Nathan sees as part of Dethklok’s medical checkup. Ate His Gun:At the end of "Dethhealth", he blows his brains out with a shotgun in front of Nathan. Creepy Shadowed Undereyes: He sports these, which contribute to his depressed, world-weary demeanor. Depraved Dentist: Played with. Nathan initially fears that his dentist will try to kill him, but he gets over it, and instead manages to befriend him, realizing that he actually does need a friend.He still kills himself after the credits roll when out hunting with Nathan later, after commenting on how he appreciates their friendship. Driven to Suicide:He blows his brains out with a shotgun in front of Nathan, leaving the poor guy splattered with his blood and looking understandably horrified.

characters.name: Týr
characters.description: A kind-hearted lumberjack who marries Serveta and becomes Skwisgaar's stepfather. Good Stepfather: While he and Skwisgaar got off on the wrong foot, Týr eventually wins him over with his kind and considerate personality, treating the guitarist like his own son. Unfortunately, Týr walks in on Serveta having a threesome with two other men and flees in horror, convincing Skwisgaar that he'sthe son of a godand his only place in the world is with Dethklok. Nice Guy: He's more than happy to take Skwisgaar under his wing and treat him like his own son. But of course, Serveta just had to cheat on him... Sickeningly Sweethearts: During his time as Serveta's husband, Týr is openly affectionate with her, and much of his early family outings with Skwisgaar involved him making out with Serveta. This aggravated Skwisgaar's preexistingdaddy issuesuntil he snaps during an argument and pushes Týr into a glass coffee table (though they eventually make up). Unfortunately, this doesn't last as Serveta cheats on him by having a threesome with two other men; Týr walks in on her and flees, unable to handle his wife's infidelity and true character.

characters.name: Caroline Bsijldfjo
characters.description: Toki's internet date. Do You Want to Copulate?: Invoked this trope, to both Toki's horror and the viewers'. Fan Disservice: Her obsession with having a child mixed with her off-putting demeanor and unpleasant looks make her repulsive in more ways than one. Gonk: She isnoteasy to look at. My Biological Clock Is Ticking: Caroline's dialogue is all about conceiving a child, from the time she's ovulating to picking out baby names.

characters.name: Get Thee Hence
characters.description: ANu Metalband recruited by Murderface and Toki after getting kicked out of Dethklok to form their own record label. Addled Addict: Their drug of choice is heroin, which leaves them in a near-permanent torpor while in Murderface's care. Murderface is shocked at them fornot bothering to get famous before forming a crippling drug habit. All Take and No Give: This defines their relationship with Murderface: they demand a massive million-dollar advance (which they blow through rather quickly) and treat him like a live-in maid, but spend the entire month so strung out on heroin that he has to basically record their entire album without their help. After all that, theystilldemand all songwriting residuals, due to the contract being filled out by Toki in Norwegian. Asshole Victim: They get brutally murdered by a crowd of Dethklok fans simply for having the temerity to open for them. Of course, they deserved every minute of it. Disco Dan: As Nathan grumpily points out, their general schtick and style was at least six years out of date by the time their starring episode was made.

characters.name: X2P1158
characters.description: A drum machine who replaces Pickles while he is in rehab. A.I. Getting High: Doesn't take too long for it to become prey toSex Drugs And Rock N Roll. A.I. Is a Crapshoot: Tries to murder the band as soon as he gets word that Pickles has gotten clean and can play with the rest of the group again.

characters.name: DoryMcClean
characters.description: Dr. Rockzo's underage lover from the 1980s, and the catalyst for Zazz Blammymatazz's breakup. Age-Gap Romance: An illegal variation with Rockzo; she was 14 at the time while he was either in his 20s or 30s. Amicable Exes: One-sided on her part. '80s Hair: Sported a feathered bob back in the day and still has it in the present, though it's brown instead of dirty blonde. Erotic Eating: When she was fourteen, she was always seen sucking on a lollipop suggestively.

characters.name: Trindle
characters.description: A crazed superfan whom Nathan dates, much to the objections of his bandmates. Anguished Declaration of Love: Her last words involve this. If I Can't Have You…: Tries to commit murder-suicide with Nathan when he tries to break up with her. Last Kiss: She manages to get one in death after blowing herself up, where her disembodied face flew through the air and smacked Nathan on the lips. Loony Fan: She loves Nathan Explosion so much that she murders any man who even looks like him.

characters.name: Sultan Sotajumala
characters.description: A dictator from a Middle Eastern country where Abigail sends Dethklok on "vacation" to help cure their writer’s block. As Long as It Sounds Foreign: ...Which it technically is, but Finnish for "war god" rather than any language in the region they're invoking. Asshole Victim: No tears are shed when his harem overthrows him and kills him. The Caligula: Used mass executions as a way oflaying off his employees. Droit du Seigneur: Had women abducted from off the street and forced into sexual servitude.

characters.name: Ludwig
characters.description: A bully from Rock-a-Rooni Fantasy Camp who targets Toki. The Bully: He constantly picks on Toki, including forcefeeding him cake, knowing damn well he's diabetic. Not to mention smashing Toki's Mordhaus snow globe to really hurt him.Unfortunately he picked a very wrong time to smash it. Gory Discretion Shot: After Nathan catches up to him and asks him about "which hand does he fret with", we hear only the sounds of his blood-curdling screams and Nathan using the broken snowglobe as anImprovised Weapon. We later see the aftermath in Nathan's room, where his severed hand is kept inside a jar. Oh, Crap!: Once the rest of the band arrive to see him bullying Toki, he visibly gulps as Nathan stares at the smashed snowglobe. One-Steve Limit: Somewhat averted as Snowball from Zazz Blammymatazz in the comics also has a son named Ludwig (aNo Celebrities Were Harmedversion of WolfgangVan Halen) with it being unclear if they're the same person, due to someCanon Discontinuitybetween the first issue and the airing of Dethzazz regarding Zazz's breakup, and comic Ludwig's introduction being via a rather trippy hallucination sequence where it's hard to tell what to take literally and what not to.
